# Filtered-subspace parent: constructive consumer calculation

2026-11-01. Gap theorem is a separately reviewed input. This is the parent-construction/algorithm/logical-transport component. In computational/global norm bounds below, n denotes total accessible spin count N=n_memory+N_bath, not memory size alone.

## 1. Exact algebra

Let H=Href+V, with Href a bounded-degree commuting bounded-support stabilizer Hamiltonian plus a bounded-dimensional product-bath Hamiltonian. Fix a valid memory syndrome sigma and an explicit bath eigenbasis label b. Let Q_a be its signed-check violation projectors and onsite bath-complement projectors. They commute with Href and each other. Their common kernel P has the supplied logical dimension d_L (two for one logical qubit).

A(s)=exp(-sH/2), L_a(s)=A(s)Q_a A(s)^-1,
F(s)=sum_a L_a(s)†L_a(s), 0<=s<=beta.

F is positive and its kernel is EXACTLY A(s)ran(P): L_a psi=0 for all a iff A^-1 psi lies in every Q_a kernel. At V=0, L_a=Q_a and F=F0=sum_a Q_a; its nonzero spectrum is bounded below by1. This statement alone says nothing about the perturbed gap.

The logical kernel dimension remains exactly d_L for every finite n,s, even if a gap closes. There is no normalization/postselection in this algebra.

## 2. Commuting-reference imaginary-time expansion

For an operator O supported on a fixed set X, exp(tHref)O exp(-tHref) involves only Href terms touching X. Every other term commutes with O and with these reference terms and cancels from the conjugation. Hence it is supported on one bounded reference star of X, and its norm is at most exp(C|t|J|X|)||O||, with constants from local dimension, support size and degree.

Set U(s)=exp(sHref/2)exp(-sH/2). Then

U'=-(1/2)V_I(s)U, V_I(s)=exp(sHref/2)V exp(-sHref/2),
L_a=exp(-sHref/2)[U Q_a U^-1]exp(sHref/2).

Each V_I term has constant support on an enlarged bounded-degree interaction graph and strength at most v exp(C beta J), uniformly over0<=s<=beta. The conjugation U Q U^-1 has its time-ordered nested-commutator expansion. Only terms connected to Q survive.

An explicit majorant is obtained as follows. If the initial support has size r0 and each enlarged interaction adds at most r* sites, then summing the norms of choices at commutator step j contributes at most2v_I(r0+j r*). The time-ordered simplex contributes (beta/2)^k/k!. Therefore the total k-th-order absolute contribution is b

# Independent audit: filtered-subspace parent consumer

2026-11-01. **PASS-CONDITIONAL for the exact parent construction, its weak-interaction representation, polynomial finite-system implementation and logical parallel-transport estimate**, with the graph and size conventions clarified below. The gap theorem, uniform relative Gram estimate and ensemble sampler remain separate inputs. No numerical fixture is treated as a theorem.

Audited file: `filtered_parent_consumer.md`, SHA256 `1d3b1ac59e14881f9d2051d3588afa3ec3f514f70cc79936582042f8cfaf65a4`.

## 1. Exact algebra and uniform signed sectors

A(s) is invertible in each finite system. Therefore the simultaneous kernel of L_a=AQ_aA^-1 is exactly A ran(P), and F=sum L_a†L_a has exactly that kernel and is positive. No postselection probability occurs. At V=0, [Href,Q_a]=0 yields L_a=Q_a and F0=sum Q_a, whose nonzero eigenvalues are positive integers; redundant commuting projectors do not invalidate the gap >=1.

A valid syndrome representative is a physical Pauli tensor product, and the bath-label change is an onsite unitary. These conjugate all signed F0 parents to a common unsigned code-plus-product parent without enlarging supports or changing norms. A stability theorem uniform over arbitrary weak perturbations in the proved interaction norm therefore applies to all labels with the same constants. This is conditional on that theorem's actual hypotheses, not a derivation of them.

## 2. Imaginary-time connected interaction bound

Because reference terms commute, only those touching the original support of a local operator enter its reference conjugation; terms outside commute with both that operator and the retained reference terms. The stated one-star support and exp(C beta |support|) norm bound are valid, including arbitrary bounded-dimensional onsite baths.

The interaction-picture differential equation and nested commutator expansion are correct. At order k, only sequences cumulatively connected to the root survive. The number/norm sum of choices is bounded by a product of affine-in-step support sizes. The simplex factorial cancels its factorial growth, leaving a polynomial(k) times a fixed constant to the k. Final reference conjugation contributes another exp(C beta k), absorbed into q. Choosing V sufficiently small at fixed beta gives a convergent exponentially support-weighted interaction decomposit
